description: A framework-agnostic declarative HTTP engine: describe how to talk to a REST API as plain         data (a spec), and the core executes it. Handles OAuth2 with token refresh, four built-in         pagination modes plus pluggable strategies, declarative post-receive response shaping,         SSRF guards, redirect safety, and design-time searchable/paginated dropdowns via         describe(...). Ships a JDK HttpClient transport and lets you plug in your own.
